description: Zukan UI: an accessible modal (mirroring the NameDialog/reset-confirm alertdialog pattern) opened from a header 📖 button, showing every canonical appearance as an entry. Undiscovered entries render as a darkened/masked SILHOUETTE of the sprite with details hidden; discovered entries show the sprite, tier+form label, first-seen date, days raised, and name. A discovered/total count is shown. Full JA/EN parity. New i18n keys (ja+en). CSS incl. silhouette + prefers-reduced-motion.
steps: Add i18n keys to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES in packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts (both required or tsc build fails; keep JA byte-identical for existing keys). Suggested keys (name consistently, keep JA natural): 'zukan.button' (JA 図鑑 / EN Zukan or Collection), 'zukan.buttonAria' (JA 図鑑を開く / EN Open collection), 'zukan.title' (JA モンスター図鑑 / EN Monster Collection), 'zukan.close' (JA 閉じる / EN Close), 'zukan.count' (JA 発見 {discovered} / {total} / EN Discovered {discovered} / {total}), 'zukan.undiscovered' (JA '？？？' / EN '???'), 'zukan.undiscoveredAria' (JA 未発見 / EN Undiscovered), 'zukan.firstSeen' (JA 初到達 / EN First reached), 'zukan.daysRaised' (JA 育成日数 / EN Days raised), 'zukan.daysUnit' (JA 日 / EN ' days' — used to format the number), 'zukan.name' (JA なまえ / EN Name), 'zukan.empty' (optional JA まだ何も発見していません / EN Nothing discovered yet). Use {discovered}/{total} placeholders resolved by the component. Place them in a clearly-commented '// Monster zukan (issue #39)' block.

Add a pure localized formatter to packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts: zukanCountLabel(discovered, total, lang) using t(lang,'zukan.count') with {discovered}/{total} replaced; and daysRaisedLabel(days, lang) = `${days}${t(lang,'zukan.daysUnit')}` for JA and `${days}${t(lang,'zukan.daysUnit')}` for EN (EN unit begins with a space). Add a first-seen date formatter firstSeenDateLabel(epochMs, lang): format via new Date(epochMs).toLocaleDateString(lang==='en'?'en-US':'ja-JP') guarded for non-finite -> ''. Keep these React/DOM-free (toLocaleDateString is available in Node) so they can be unit-tested; add focused tests in game-ui.test.ts for zukanCountLabel + daysRaisedLabel (assert the {discovered}/{total} substitution and the unit suffix for both langs). Do NOT assert exact locale date strings (locale-data-dependent); if you test firstSeenDateLabel assert only non-empty for a finite ms and '' for NaN.

Create packages/frontend/src/components/ZukanModal.tsx. Props: { zukan: Zukan; onClose: () => void }. Mirror NameDialog.tsx: role='dialog' (or 'alertdialog') + aria-modal='true' + aria-label={t('zukan.title')}, focus moved to the close button (or a heading with tabIndex) on open via useEffect, Escape closes (onKeyDown), a focus trap cycling through focusable controls (at minimum the Close button; include any entry buttons if focusable), and focus restoration handled by the parent (App). Render the title, the discovered/total count (zukanCountLabel using discoveredCount(zukan) + ZUKAN_TOTAL from @ddm/shared), and a grid/list iterating ZUKAN_APPEARANCES (the canonical order) so EVERY appearance has a cell.

For each appearance cell: compute discovered = isDiscovered(zukan, stageId, form) (from @ddm/shared) and look up the entry by appearanceKey. If discovered: render <MonsterSprite stageId={stageId} form={form} size={96} /> at normal appearance, the label `${stageLabel(stageId,lang)} ・ ${formLabel(form,lang)}` (for baby:base where formLabel returns '', show just the stage label), the name, firstSeenDateLabel(entry.firstSeenAt,lang) under t('zukan.firstSeen'), and daysRaisedLabel(entry.daysRaised,lang) under t('zukan.daysRaised'). If NOT discovered: render the SAME MonsterSprite but wrapped in an element with a 'zukan-silhouette' class that darkens/masks it via CSS (e.g. filter: brightness(0) + opacity, or a dark overlay), show t('zukan.undiscovered') ('？？？'/'???') as the label, hide all detail fields, and give the cell an accessible name via aria-label={t('zukan.undiscoveredAria')} so SR users know it is undiscovered (details must be genuinely hidden, not just visually). Mark the silhouetted sprite aria-hidden so it is not announced.

In packages/frontend/src/App.tsx add a header 📖 button next to the reset/lang controls that opens the zukan. Add state const [zukanOpen, setZukanOpen] = useState(false) and a zukanTriggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null). The button: type=button, className e.g. 'zukan-btn', aria-label={t('zukan.buttonAria')}, title same, text 📖 (and/or t('zukan.button')); onClick setZukanOpen(true). Render {zukanOpen && <ZukanModal zukan={readZukan()} onClose={closeZukan} />} where closeZukan = useCallback(() => { setZukanOpen(false); zukanTriggerRef.current?.focus(); }, []). Read the zukan via readZukan() from ui-helpers at open time so it reflects the latest storage (the modal is short-lived; no need to subscribe). Import ZukanModal + readZukan. Keep the button enabled regardless of monster load state (the collection is independent of the live monster).

Add styles to packages/frontend/src/styles.css: a modal overlay/box styled like .name-dialog/.reset-confirm (reuse those visual conventions), a responsive grid for the entries (.zukan-grid / .zukan-cell), and the .zukan-silhouette rule that darkens the sprite (e.g. filter: brightness(0) saturate(0); opacity: .55; or a mask). Ensure any entrance/transition animation is disabled under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) consistent with the existing reduced-motion handling in the file. Keep it visually consistent with existing panels.

Full verification: export PATH; npm run build (whole monorepo, frontend tsc catches any missing i18n key or type error); npm test (shared green); npm test -w @ddm/frontend (green, count includes the new zukanCountLabel/daysRaisedLabel tests). Manually reason through: open modal shows 10 cells, undiscovered as silhouette with ???/未発見, discovered show sprite+labels+first-seen+days+name, count reads discovered/10, JA and EN both render.
acceptance_criteria: A header 📖/図鑑 button opens an accessible modal (role=dialog/alertdialog, aria-modal, focus-on-open, Escape closes, focus trap, focus restored to the trigger on close).

The modal lists all 10 canonical appearances; undiscovered ones render as a darkened SILHOUETTE with details hidden and an 'undiscovered' accessible label; discovered ones show sprite, tier+form label, first-seen date, days raised, and name.
A discovered/total count (e.g. 発見 3 / 10) is displayed and correct.
All new strings exist in BOTH ja and en; the modal renders correctly in each language; JA for existing keys is unchanged.
prefers-reduced-motion is respected for any modal/entry animation.
`npm run build` passes; `npm test` and `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` pass with the new helper tests.
findings: Added 13 zukan i18n keys to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES in i18n.ts under a '// Monster zukan (issue #39)' block (zukan.button/buttonAria/title/close/count/undiscovered/undiscoveredAria/firstSeen/daysRaised/daysUnit/name/empty); EN daysUnit begins with a leading space (' days'); existing JA/EN strings left byte-identical. Added 3 pure React/DOM-free formatters to ui-helpers.ts: zukanCountLabel(discovered,total,lang) ({discovered}/{total} substitution over zukan.count), daysRaisedLabel(days,lang)=`${days}${zukan.daysUnit}`, firstSeenDateLabel(epochMs,lang)=toLocaleDateString('en-US'|'ja-JP') guarded to '' for non-finite. Created components/ZukanModal.tsx mirroring NameDialog: role=dialog + aria-modal + aria-label=zukan.title, focus moved to Close button on open (useEffect), Escape closes, focus trap over focusable controls (queried from box ref), parent handles focus restore. Iterates ZUKAN_APPEARANCES (10 cells); discovered -> MonsterSprite size=96 + stage label (+ ' ・ '+form only when formLabel non-empty, so baby:base shows stage only) + name + firstSeen date + daysRaised; undiscovered -> same sprite wrapped in .zukan-silhouette aria-hidden, label zukan.undiscovered, ALL detail fields genuinely omitted, cell aria-label=zukan.undiscoveredAria. App.tsx: added zukanOpen state + zukanTriggerRef + closeZukan useCallback (restores focus to trigger), a 📖 'zukan-btn' header button (aria-label/title=zukan.buttonAria, enabled regardless of monster load state) before the reset-btn, and {zukanOpen && <ZukanModal zukan={readZukan()} onClose={closeZukan}/>} rendered at open time; imported ZukanModal + readZukan. styles.css: .zukan-btn, .zukan-modal overlay + .zukan-box (styled like .name-dialog with zukan-in entrance keyframe), responsive .zukan-grid (auto-fill minmax 140px) + .zukan-cell, .zukan-silhouette (filter: brightness(0) saturate(0); opacity:.55), and a prefers-reduced-motion block disabling the box animation (matches existing convention). Added 3 focused tests to game-ui.test.ts (zukanCountLabel substitution JA/EN, daysRaisedLabel unit suffix JA/EN, firstSeenDateLabel non-empty for finite ms / '' for non-finite). Verified: npm run build (whole monorepo incl. frontend tsc+vite) passes; npm test (shared) 126 pass/0 fail; npm test -w @ddm/frontend 107 pass/0 fail (baseline 104, +3). No new runtime deps; no shared/backend/infra/Monster-type changes. dist/ build artifacts are gitignored (not staged).
